scripts.build: pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/sdk build && pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/relayer build && pnpm build:evm
scripts.test: pnpm test:sdk && pnpm test:relayer && pnpm test:evm
scripts.setup:evm: cd evm && forge soldeer install --config-location foundry
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/sdk format:check && pnpm --filter @private-launchpad/relayer format:check && forge fmt --root evm --check
